item.description:
Benson Sun
多單插到前低都停損出場了。

原本看多邏輯是 BTC 近一個月跨資產表現強勢＋120D MA 支撐，但這兩天明顯弱於美股，邏輯失效。

目前 BTC 永續合約 OI 高、多空比（LSUR ）也很高。

通常情況下多空比高通常是價格相對低點，但價格陰跌＋高持倉+高 LSUR的組合下，下跌的尾部風險會明顯放大。

利潤回撤很多，但八月底以來還是有賺，先收手觀望一下。
tweet

item.description:

Photos 📸 from the compute maxxing salon we hosted are out! shoutouts to cohosts @silicondata and @JacobKerr17 as well as all the speakers, debaters and attendees! The room gathered a great mix of investors, neoclouds, compute traders and researchers.

Learnt so much from @0xhopydoc @stevehou's talk on the forward curve, as well as @tarunchitra @hrojantorse @jonah_b demystifying compute financing & debts' problems. - danning

item.title: Macau Business Beijing’s top prosecutor has pledged continued support for the Ma
item.description:
Macau Business
Beijing’s top prosecutor has pledged continued support for the Macau Special Administrative Region’s Public Prosecutions Office (MP) in bolstering judicial cooperation with its counterparts across Portuguese-speaking countries, underscoring the necessity of international collaboration to counter increasingly complex cross-border crime.
Speaking on Tuesday at the opening of the 23rd Meeting of Prosecutors General of Portuguese-Speaking Countries and Regions in Macau, Ying Yong, Procurator-General of the Supreme People’s Procuratorate of China, stressed that evolving security challenges require stronger international mechanisms.
https://t.co/dWAJ8pAdBr
